node: Advanced packaging capacity, bonding, substrates, inspection, and test
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the advanced-packaging capacity node. The reference lane is TSMC because its CoWoS, SoIC and other 3DFabric packaging technologies sit directly between AI accelerator wafer output and finished GPU/ASIC modules. The underfollowed lane focuses on smaller public suppliers tied to throughput, yield and qualification: Camtek for inspection/metrology in advanced packaging, chiplets and HBM; and Aehr Test Systems for wafer-level and packaged-part burn-in/test of AI processors.
